description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget 'AttendanceScreen' that provides a UI for selecting a date range, fetching attendance records via a provider, and displaying the list of attendance entries with status indicators.

classes.name: AttendanceScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a date range selector, fetch button, and list of attendance records.

classes.name: _AttendanceScreenState
classes.description: State class for AttendanceScreen managing date range, loading state, and fetched data.

classes.name: _StatusChip
classes.description: StatelessWidget that displays the attendance status with a color-coded Chip.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches attendance data within the selected date range via provider and updates the UI.

methods.name: _pickRange
methods.description: Opens a date range picker dialog and updates the start and end dates based on user selection.
